<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 360" width="500" height="360">
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Axes -->
  <line x1="60" y1="280" x2="450" y2="280" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="60" y1="280" x2="60" y2="50" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

  <!-- Arrowheads -->
  <polygon points="450,276 460,280 450,284" fill="#000000" />
  <polygon points="56,50 60,40 64,50" fill="#000000" />

  <!-- Axis Labels -->
  <text x="450" y="305" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Energy</text>
  <text x="30" y="60" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Number of</text>
  <text x="30" y="76" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">molecules</text>

  <!-- Curve T1 (lower, broader peak shifted right) -->
  <!-- Peak around x=180, height ~ 160 -->
  <path d="M 60,280 C 80,280 120,200 180,130 C 240,60 300,260 420,278" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

  <!-- Curve T2 (higher, taller peak shifted left) -->
  <!-- Peak around x=130, height ~ 220 -->
  <path d="M 60,280 C 80,280 100,100 130,70 C 160,40 240,270 400,278" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

  <!-- Labels for curves -->
  <text x="145" y="55" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">T</text>
  <text x="152" y="59" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">1</text>

  <text x="210" y="115" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">T</text>
  <text x="217" y="119" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">2</text>

  <!-- Activation energy line -->
  <line x1="330" y1="280" x2="330" y2="90" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="5,4" />
  <text x="330" y="298" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">E</text>
  <text x="338" y="302" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">cat</text>

  <!-- Fig caption -->
  <text x="250" y="340" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 5.1</text>
</svg>
